patterns.note: Sections are often introduced by full-width, full-height blocks dominated by extremely large, bold typography, acting as visual anchors and dramatic dividers.
The site employs a dramatic contrast between monumental, uppercase sans-serif display headings and more understated serif body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently used for text and backgrounds, punctuated by vibrant primary color accents (red, green, blue) within specific content or motion elements.
Large text elements and content sections are revealed with a staggered slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reading experience.
The hero background image/video subtly scales and parallaxes as the user scrolls, adding depth behind the initial static text overlay.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a large, static text overlay that scales down and fades out as the user scrolls, revealing the content below.
A sticky header bar transitions from a transparent state to a solid black background with white text after a specific scroll depth, maintaining navigation visibility.

Content sections and large typographic statements are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements slide up or fade in with a slight delay as they become visible in the viewport, leveraging `css-keyframes`.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~8-10x body text) create dramatic visual impact, contrasted with smaller, more refined serif body and sans-serif label text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous vertical spacing between sections, large margins around text blocks), but with some dense elements like the client list.

standout: The site's standout feature is its audacious use of extremely large, bold, uppercase typography as primary visual elements and section dividers, combined with dynamic scroll-triggered reveals and a striking, high-contrast color palette. This creates a powerful, almost architectural feel that is highly distinctive.
